test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can finish as much work in 6 days as C can in 8 days. B can finish as much work in 6 days as C can in 4 days. How much time will B require to finish a work if A takes 54 days to finish it?
solution:
**Given:**

A can finish as much work in 6 days as C can in 8 days.

B can finish as much work in 6 days as C can in 4 days.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the worker × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of the A, B, and C be a, b, and c

According to the question,

6a = 8c

⇒ a/c = 8/6 = 4/3 ----(i)

Again,

6b = 4c

⇒ b/c = 4/6 = 2/3 ----(ii)

From eq (i) and eq (ii) we can say

a : b : c = 4 : 2 : 3

Let efficiency of them be 4x and 2x and 3x

Now,

Required work = 54 × 4x

⇒ 216x

Required time = 216x/2x

⇒ 108 days

**∴ B will require 108 days to finish a work if A takes 54 days to finish it.**
